تستقرضي (form X)
# تَسْتَقْرِضِي (tastaqriḍī) /tas.taq.ri.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
# تُسْتَقْرَضِي (tustaqraḍī) /tus.taq.ra.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
